description: Kestrel Motor Group customer feedback theme taxonomy
developed_from: Analysis of ~5,300 customer comments across 24 dealerships

themes.definition: Whether the customer was kept informed about the status of their vehicle, booking, or order — or had to chase for information.
themes.includes: SMS/text updates, phone callbacks, progress calls, being left in the dark, messages lost, hold times
themes.excludes: Explanations of technical work (see Vehicle Knowledge), booking confirmations (see Booking System)
examples: Heard from Gaz twice before lunch. Knew where I stood the whole time.
no updates at all, car just sat there and i had to ring every day
Left my number for a call back, was told 'by close of business'. Still no call.

themes.definition: Whether the price was fair, transparent, and matched what was quoted or agreed.
themes.includes: Quoted vs actual price, hidden fees, admin charges, upselling, labour rate discrepancies, value for money
themes.excludes: Finance terms (see Sales Process), parts pricing when the issue is availability (see Parts Availability)
examples: Quote was $520. Paid $790. Not a single call to say it was going up.
Cost me less than a tank of fuel and a pizza. Not complaining.
Receipt shows an add on for a 'premium' oil filter I didn't ask for.

themes.definition: How long the customer waited — whether at the dealership, for the vehicle to be ready, or in a queue.
themes.includes: Service completion time, pickup delays, counter queues, promised vs actual times
themes.excludes: Parts delays (see Parts Availability), booking availability (see Booking System)
examples: In and out before my coffee went cold.
HOURS AND HOURS FOR WHAT SHOULD'VE BEEN A QUICK JOB.
Waited 2 hours past the pickup time they gave me.

themes.definition: How staff treated the customer — warmth, respect, helpfulness, or rudeness and dismissiveness.
themes.includes: Greetings, helpfulness, attitude, rudeness, being ignored, being made to feel welcome, named staff praise/complaints
themes.excludes: Technical explanations (see Vehicle Knowledge), communication about progress (see Communication)
examples: Fantastic people. Smiled, said g'day and looked after me from the start.
counter bloke just shoved the clipboard at me
Kylie kept pushing the premium care package even after I said no.

themes.definition: Whether the actual work on the vehicle was done correctly and completely.
themes.includes: Faults returning after repair, sloppy work, grease/dirt left on vehicle, misaligned parts, incomplete repairs
themes.excludes: Wait time for the repair (see Timeliness), parts not available (see Parts Availability)
examples: Replaced the tyre and left the wheel nuts not tightened properly.
Still smells like mould when I turn the fan on.
Brought my car in with a puddle forming under it. Puddle's still forming.

themes.definition: Any issue that could endanger the customer or others. ALWAYS flagged for human review.
themes.includes: Loose wheel nuts, brake problems after repair, seat sliding, grease on pedals, dangerous repair quality
themes.excludes: General repair quality issues that are not dangerous (see Repair & Service Quality)
examples: Replaced the tyre and left the wheel nuts not tightened properly. Heard thumping on the freeway.
Seat still slides back every time I brake. Dangerous.
Plenty of grease on the carpet and the pedals. My shoes slipped off the brake.

subthemes: No availability / long wait for slot
themes.definition: Problems or praise related to making, changing, or honouring service appointments.
themes.includes: Online booking failures, lost bookings, availability, double-bookings, rescheduling, booking confirmation issues
themes.excludes: Wait time once at the dealership (see Timeliness), general website issues unrelated to booking
examples: Booked on the new website, got a confirmation number, turned up and they had no record of me.
Can't even get an appointment on a weekday, let alone a Saturday.
the new online booking system has twice lost my appointment.

themes.definition: Whether required parts were available or caused delays.
themes.includes: Out of stock, back-order, supply chain delays, parts arriving late, no update on parts ETA
themes.excludes: Parts pricing (see Pricing & Charges), counter service attitude (see Staff Attitude)
examples: Part delay. Ute off the road. Money lost. Fix it.
Told the EGR valve was on national back-order.
Part came in on the day they said. Can't fault the timing.

themes.definition: Whether staff explained vehicle features, service work, or paperwork clearly.
themes.includes: Feature walkthroughs, service explanations, invoice explanations, dashboard warning lights, finance paperwork
themes.excludes: Communication about service progress/updates (see Communication), sales pressure (see Sales Process)
examples: Told me straight what the adaptive cruise does and doesn't do.
Walked me through the finance application and what each box meant.
Explained the tyre pressure monitor and the spare situation.

themes.definition: The experience of buying a vehicle — from negotiation to driving away.
themes.includes: Test drives, negotiations, finance, delivery, handover completeness, add-on pressure, fleet ordering
themes.excludes: Post-sale service (see Repair/Service Quality), general staff friendliness (see Staff Attitude)
examples: Took delivery of a car with a fuel tank on empty and tyres underinflated.
Salesperson wouldn't let me leave to think it over.
Whole thing from test drive to handover was painless.

themes.definition: The physical environment — waiting areas, amenities, cleanliness.
themes.includes: Coffee machine, chairs, toilets, temperature, cleanliness, smell, parking
themes.excludes: Counter queues (see Timeliness), staff at the desk (see Staff Attitude)
examples: No coffee machine working again, bit rich for a premium dealer.
Dark, dingy and smells a bit damp.
Waiting area was freezing and filthy with old coffee cups.

themes.definition: General positive sentiment that doesn't map to a specific operational theme.
themes.includes: General praise, 'easy', 'no dramas', 'painless', welcoming for newcomers, returning loyalty
themes.excludes: Specific positive themes like 'quick service' (Timeliness) or 'good price' (Pricing) — use those instead when specific
examples: Easy for a bloke who hates dealerships.
Moved here a couple of months ago and got greeted like an old mate.
No bother whatsoever.

themes.definition: Comments too brief, vague, or unintelligible to classify meaningfully.
themes.includes: Single-word feedback, completely ambiguous statements, garbled text
themes.excludes: Short but clear statements like 'Part delay. Fix it.' (classifiable as Parts Availability)
examples: Please call. That's all.
Too slow mate.
